structural_change: smh_tile_rp4lp (457.92 x 1598.4, aspect 3.49, 13/18 macros off the 43.2 lattice, 2,069-b landing read select 8,284 loads, gate1 GRT ovf 51,363, gate2 CTS rc 2) split along its lp region cut into two hardened halves (ot_hbm_smh_rp4h_n / _s) abutting in the SM frame slot: no landing (registered tile-to-tile crossing on the abutment face, judged per linked child-flop pair at die level), the two hard 216x43.2 land children replaced by soft kept landing registers (rl1 no longer crosses a macro), every macro on the 43.2 lattice, BF16 columns / transpose re-oriented so operand inputs face the x store and sums face the transpose, one clock root per half with clk on the abutment face beside the n half's.  Latency identical to the lp record (gout +3, all else 0).  SAFE2 successor of smh_rp4hs_a1019 (its gate failed the clock rule: one spine root from the abutment corner, TT insertion ~2.1 ns, boundary pin-flop spread ~200 ps): regional k-means clock roots (clock_split_km.tcl K=64, each root <= ~115 um across) under one balanced CTS top tree, hard-child clock pins on TritonCTS macro trees (lib insertion), clk entry moved to the W face at the half's centre height; io_hold_margin 0.03.  Cycles unchanged.
